List the operations of the Voidhash API, or those whose id, path or description holds every word you
pass.

Usage:
  voidhash api list [search...] [flags]

Arguments:
  search  Words that must all appear in the operation's id, path or description

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command
      --json  Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash api list
  voidhash api list webhooks
  voidhash api list person erase --json
